outside.description: Whether its words may leave the host in a push.

pushed.description: Each time a host told it outside Tilo.

items.description: One time a host told a thing outside Tilo.

took.description: How many of the person's devices took it.

reaches.description: Whether it is to reach the person now, on their devices.

seq.description: Its place in the log. A thing that changes takes a new place and keeps its id.

task.description: The task a thing told belongs to: an issue of a tracker.

title.description: A few words over it; empty when it has none.

withdrawnAtMs.description: When what it tells was taken back, in milliseconds since the epoch.

words.description: What is told, as plain text.
